system.description:
Switching it on takes a combat action. While on, the wearer recovers 10 Endurance at the start of each turn, waking at 1 or more; someone dead for less than an hour revives and recovers at the same rate. Missing limbs regrow in five turns. A wearer with a cybernetic limb drops to -5 Endurance and bleeds out until it's switched off. Runs 10 rounds per Alien Power Cell. Alien artefact: making it usable by a human takes a Repair check (12, or 8 with 2,000cr and a week).

Exploration Supplement
